units.source_text: 他不断地捉弄站长，开玩笑，挨责备，还手不停地给火盆添炭，时而在黑板上写些数字。

en.t: He kept teasing the stationmaster, cracking jokes, getting scolded, and still, without stopping his hands, adding charcoal to the brazier, while from time to time writing numbers on the blackboard.

units.source_text: 生活的迷惑，或者说对生活的妒忌，又要再度使我成为俘虏。

en.t: The bewilderment of life, or rather my jealousy of life, was once again about to make me its prisoner.

units.source_text: 我也可以不去烧金阁，从寺庙跑出来，还俗，这样完全埋没在生活里。

en.t: I could also choose not to go and burn the Golden Pavilion, run out of the temple, return to secular life, and in that way bury myself completely in living.
